What is the main principle of a keto diet?

The keto diet is a high-fat, very low-carb diet that puts your body into ketosis. The typical macro ratio is 70-80% fat, 20-25% protein, and 5-10% carbohydrates, forcing your body to use fat for fuel instead of glucose
